name: kg-suite-vertical-router
description: Auto-detect + route any Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite artifact (Decision Card / Incident Card / Evidence Bundle / audit-stream event / state-tracker event) to the right vertical-specific verification logic across all 10 vertical 6-packs (60 spec repos) AND their 10 AGPL-3.0 reference implementations. Supports BOTH spec-shape and ref-impl-shape audit-stream events.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.mjs examples/healthtech-fhir-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/edtech-student-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/proptech-mortgage-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/insurtech-claims-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/hrtech-employment-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/fintech-credit-event.ndjson
scripts.demo:refimpl: node src/cli.mjs examples/healthtech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/legaltech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/energytech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/defensetech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/govtech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/fintech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/hrtech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/edtech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/proptech-refimpl-event.ndjson && node src/cli.mjs examples/insurtech-refimpl-event.ndjson
scripts.demo:all: npm run demo && npm run demo:refimpl
